person_note: Stephanie Plum is the participating first-person base narrator. The authorized opening establishes that voice, while numerous independent interior Goodreads passages continue it through narratorial “I,” “my,” and “we”; a series-wide source also explicitly identifies the stories as first-person. First-person language inside dialogue, epigraphs, and universal reflections was kept local rather than counted as base evidence. No credible indication of alternating, framed, epistolary, second-person, or third-person sections was found.
